run_olmo_export_to_executorch: run the optimum-cli to export an OLMo model to ExecuTorch format with xnnpack recipe
run_olmo_text_generation_xnnpack: run text generation with the OLMo model using the xnnpack ExecuTorch recipe
run_olmo_text_generation_custom_sdpa: run text generation with OLMo using custom SDPA and 8da4w linear quantization
run_olmo_text_generation_kv_cache: run text generation with OLMo using custom SDPA and a custom KV cache
run_olmo_text_generation_portable: run text generation with the OLMo model using the portable ExecuTorch recipe
